cli.err.storeInUse: The Mosaic app has this vault open. Quit it, or give the CLI its own device with `mosaic setup own-store`.
cli.err.noStore: No vault found at {path}. Set up Mosaic in the app first, or pass --store.
cli.err.noAccount: This store has no account yet.
cli.err.wrongCredentials: Wrong master password or Secret Key.
cli.err.secretKeyInvalid: That Secret Key is not valid. Check it against your Emergency Kit.
cli.err.inputRequired: Input is needed, but --no-input is set.
cli.err.ambiguousRef: More than one item matches {ref}. Use a more exact reference or the item ID.
cli.err.noOtp: This item has no one-time password.
cli.err.revealRequired: {field} is secret. Add --reveal to print it, or --copy to put it on the clipboard.
cli.err.vaultUnavailable: That vault is hardware-protected or not available here.
cli.err.rotationInProgress: Finish the key change in the Mosaic app first.
cli.err.secretInArgv: {flag} would put a secret on the command line. Use the prompt, --password-stdin or --password-fd instead.
cli.err.fdUnsupported: --password-fd is not available on this system.
cli.err.sessionExpired: The unlock session has ended. Enter your master password.
cli.err.sessionNotCached: No unlock session could be saved (the OS keystore or the runtime folder is not available). Every command will ask for your master password.
cli.err.twoFactorMethodUnsupported: This account signs in with a security key, which the command line cannot use. Add an authenticator-app code in the desktop app, then try again.
cli.err.envSecretIgnored: {name} is set but ignored. Mosaic never reads secrets from the environment.
cli.err.exportUnreadable: The file cannot be read: wrong passphrase or damaged file.
cli.err.importFailed: The file could not be imported.
cli.err.syncNotConfigured: Sync is not set up for this store.
cli.err.syncSessionRevoked: This account's keys were renewed on another device, so this session ended. Sign in again with the new Secret Key from your newest Emergency Kit.
cli.err.syncSessionPasswordChanged: Your master password was changed on another device, so this session ended. Sign in again with the new password.
cli.err.syncSessionDeviceRemoved: This device was removed from your account on another device, so this session ended. Sign in again to add it back.
cli.err.syncSessionOperator: The operator of the server ended this session. Sign in again to keep syncing.
cli.err.fileExists: {path} already exists. Mosaic does not overwrite files.
cli.err.passphraseWeak: Use a passphrase of at least {min} characters.
cli.err.badEnvName: {name} is not a valid environment variable name.
cli.err.noVaultChosen: Several vaults exist. Choose one with --vault.
cli.err.notSupported: {what} is not available in this version of the CLI.
cli.prompt.newPassword: New master password (the one you set elsewhere):
cli.out.recovered: Recovered. This device now uses your new master password.
cli.warn.revealToTerminal: Secret values are printed to the terminal and stay in its scrollback.
cli.out.unlocked: Unlocked for {minutes} minutes. Run `mosaic lock` when you are done.
cli.label.title: Title
cli.import.duplicates: {count} look like duplicates and are skipped.
cli.import.warnings: {count} entries could not be read and are left out.
cli.export.attachmentWarn: {count} items have attachments. They are included.
cli.export.attachmentsLeftOut: {count} attachment files are not in the export. Use --include-attachments.
cli.setup.done: This device is set up as its own store. Run `mosaic sync`.
cli.ssh.agentStatus: The SSH agent runs in the Mosaic app. The CLI does not run one.
